source_text: For example, in Indonesia's diverse ethnic tapestry, animist-influenced communities in regions like Kalimantan integrate pricking ceremonies with Islamic sunat perempuan, viewing persistence as resistance to Western secularism and preservation of ethnic cohesion. [87]
